name: Barbexaclone
summary: Barbexaclone (Maliasin) is a salt compound of phenobarbital and levopropylhexedrine. It was introduced in 1965. It has been reported to be as effective as phenobarbital but better tolerated; however, as of 2004, these "promising results" had not yet been confirmed nor denied in controlled trials.

pharmacology.en: In the body the salt separates into its two parts. The phenobarbital acts on GABA-A receptors to damp brain activity and stop seizures, while the propylhexedrine part is a mild stimulant.
pharmacology.zh: 在體內，這個鹽會分解成兩個部分。苯巴比妥作用於 GABA-A 受體以抑制腦部活動並制止癲癇發作，而丙基己君部分則是溫和的興奮劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 在体内，这个盐会分解成两个部分。苯巴比妥作用于 GABA-A 受体以抑制脑部活动并制止癫痫发作，而丙基己君部分则是温和的兴奋剂。

uses.en: It was used as an anticonvulsant for epilepsy. It has been reported to work about as well as phenobarbital while being better tolerated, though that claim was later questioned.
uses.zh: 它曾作為抗癲癇藥使用。據報告它的效果與苯巴比妥相當而耐受性更好，但這項說法後來受到質疑。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为抗癫痫药使用。据报告它的效果与苯巴比妥相当而耐受性更好，但这项说法后来受到质疑。

sideEffects.en: Its effects are mainly those of phenobarbital: drowsiness, poor coordination, confusion and, with long use, tolerance and dependence. Stopping suddenly can cause seizures that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 它的反應主要來自苯巴比妥：嗜睡、協調變差、混亂，長期使用還會產生耐受性與依賴。突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的反应主要来自苯巴比妥：嗜睡、协调制差、混乱，长期使用还会产生耐受性与依赖。突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a salt made by pairing phenobarbital, a sedative, with levopropylhexedrine, a stimulant. The idea, introduced in 1965, was that the stimulant would offset the drowsiness.
fact.zh: 它是把鎮靜劑苯巴比妥與興奮劑左旋丙基己君配對而成的鹽。1965 年推出時的構想是，興奮劑能抵銷鎮靜造成的嗜睡。
fact.zhHans: 它是把镇静剂苯巴比妥与兴奋剂左旋丙基己君配对而成的盐。1965 年推出时的构想是，兴奋剂能抵销镇静造成的嗜睡。
